notes.note: Reviewed the setup presentation delta: public install proof is now called Setup info, repeated identity/access explanation is removed from the approved status, and setup buttons retain 44px touch targets without grid stretching. Preparation, clipboard data, independent Station comparison, approval and recovery authority are unchanged. Existing guide and Agent contract claims remain accurate. Both mounted native intake and route profile suites pass 83 tests; actual device geometry remains to be checked.
